resources.string: Show the time of another zone where the seconds normally are, with a three-letter name. A + or - after the name means it is already tomorrow or still yesterday there. After a battery change it comes back as soon as the phone connects.
%1$s. Three letters, A to Z. Leave empty and the name comes from the zone.
Connect to the watch again as soon as the phone\'s Bluetooth is switched back on, without opening the app.

The phone can draw a picture for you: a stock or crypto price, your next calendar event or your open to-dos. It is refreshed every 15 minutes while the watch is connected and replaces your own picture.
Your next event in the coming 7 days.
Your open to-dos from Tasks.org or OpenTasks, the ones due soonest first.
Allow Gadgetbridge to read your tasks in the Android settings.
Install Tasks.org or OpenTasks to show your to-dos.
Could not read it right now. The watch keeps the last picture.
Prices from CoinGecko, no account needed. The change and the line cover the last 24 hours. Needs the Internet Helper app.
